visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Average Computed with Integer Division
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The average of 3 and 4 should be 3.5, but the program prints 3.0.

solution.explanation: When both operands are ints, the division is an integer division: 7 / 2 is 3, and the result is only then widened to double 3.0. Making one operand a double (2.0) switches to floating-point division.
